changes.open_actions: Each deal has up to three open next actions, ordered by due date with undated actions last and ID as a tie-breaker. Each action has id, owner, description and nullable due_on. Structured items are excluded. Each action also has producer-owned item_id, next_action:<UUID> or capture_post_call_action:<UUID>, matching the Home exact-card identity. IDs are table-local; clients must use item_id for card destinations. This field is additive in 2.1.0. The existing action-link resolver does not accept these task kinds.
changes.last_step: Each deal has the latest logged activity or completed next action, or null. It contains kind, summary and occurred_at. Activity kind and summary are preserved. Completed actions use kind completed_action and their outcome, falling back to the action description when no outcome is recorded. Field edits and last_touch are not steps.
